name: 8-Game Mix
description: 8-Game Mix (HORSE-style): rotation of eight poker variants (e.g. Hold'em, Omaha Hi-Lo, Razz, Stud, Stud Hi-Lo, etc.). Each round or orbit switches game. USA; popular in mixed games.

rules.objective: Win pots in each of the eight games in rotation; each round or orbit switches to the next game in the sequence.
rules.gameplay: Fixed sequence of eight poker variants. Each player deals (or has the button) once per game before rotating to the next. Rules of the current game apply.
keyRules: Complete round of each game before switching
Typical mix: Hold'em, Omaha Hi-Lo, Razz, Stud, Stud Hi-Lo, etc.

strategy.basic: Know all eight games; tighten in weak games.
strategy.intermediate: Switch strategy per game; exploit specialists in one variant.
strategy.advanced: Table selection; mixed-game edge in weaker variants.
tips: Rotation of 8 games (e.g. Hold'em, Omaha, Razz, Stud, etc.).

variations.name: HORSE (5-game)
variations.description: Five-game rotation: Limit Hold'em, Omaha Hi-Lo, Razz, Seven-Card Stud, Stud Hi-Lo Eight or Better.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: HORSE only shortens the rotation list; base engine already models limit betting and stud versus holdem structure.

variations.name: C.H.O.R.S.E. (6-game)
variations.description: Adds Crazy Pineapple to HORSE; six variants in rotation.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: CHORSE adds Crazy Pineapple to the mix but keeps the same betting and phase structure; no separate engine overrides are modeled yet.

scoring.description: Chips/pot per hand; no aggregate score—standard poker.
scoring.winCondition: Win pots in each of the eight games in rotation; each round or orbit switches to the next game in the sequence.
